status: Draft for public comment and counsel review. Not yet in force for any assessment.
ratings: Evidence demonstrates the requirement is implemented and operating.
The requirement is implemented in part or operates inconsistently. A finding is issued with a remediation window.
Evidence is absent or the practice contradicts the requirement. A finding is issued and certification cannot issue until remediated.
The requirement does not apply to the organization's processing, with the rationale documented by the assessor.
decisionRule: Every criterion marked Mandatory must be rated Met or Not Applicable for certification to issue.

Criteria not marked Mandatory may be rated Partially Met, provided the organization accepts a remediation plan with a dated window, and no more than one quarter of applicable non-mandatory criteria are rated below Met.

All findings are delivered in writing with the criterion cited by identifier. The organization remediates and resubmits evidence. Certification issues only when the decision rule is satisfied on the assessment date.
Certification attests conformance to these criteria on the assessment date. It is not a determination of legal compliance, which only regulators and courts can make.

domains.name: Governance and Accountability
domains.intro: Whether privacy is owned, documented, and overseen as a program rather than treated as a policy page.

criteria.title: Designated privacy owner
criteria.req: A named individual or role is accountable for the privacy program, with documented responsibilities and executive reporting.

criteria.title: Written privacy program
criteria.req: An internal privacy policy or program document defines principles, roles, and procedures, is approved by leadership, and is reviewed at least annually.
ev: Internal privacy policy with approval and review dates

criteria.title: Data inventory
criteria.req: The organization maintains a current inventory of personal information it processes, including categories, sources, purposes, recipients, and retention, updated when processing changes.
ev: Data inventory or record of processing activities

criteria.title: Privacy risk assessment
criteria.req: New or materially changed processing of personal information is assessed for privacy risk before launch, with documented outcomes and mitigations.

criteria.title: Retention schedule
criteria.req: A retention and deletion schedule defines how long each category of personal information is kept and the basis for that period.

criteria.title: Data classification
criteria.req: Personal information is classified by sensitivity, and handling requirements are defined for each class.

criteria.title: Leadership oversight
criteria.req: Privacy program status, incidents, and risks are reported to executive leadership or the board at least annually.
ev: Meeting minutes or reporting decks, redacted

domains.name: Transparency and Consent
domains.intro: Whether people are told the truth about processing, at the right time, and given real choices.

criteria.title: Complete privacy notice
criteria.req: A consumer-facing privacy notice accurately describes categories collected, sources, purposes, disclosures, retention, consumer rights, and contact methods, and carries an effective date.

criteria.title: Notice at collection
criteria.req: Consumers are informed at or before the point of collection of the categories collected and the purposes of use.

criteria.title: Consent where required
criteria.req: Where law or the organization's own notice requires consent, it is obtained through an affirmative act, is specific to the purpose, and is recorded.

criteria.title: Opt-out of sale and sharing
criteria.req: Where applicable, consumers can opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information through an accessible mechanism, and browser opt-out preference signals are honored.

criteria.title: No manipulative design
criteria.req: Consent, opt-out, and rights interfaces are designed so that declining is as easy as accepting and choices are not obtained through confusing or coercive design.

criteria.title: Children's data
criteria.req: Where the organization knowingly processes children's personal information, age screening, parental consent, and heightened protections are implemented as applicable.

domains.name: Individual Rights
domains.intro: Whether people can actually exercise their rights, on time, without being punished for it.

criteria.title: Request channels
criteria.req: Consumers can submit rights requests through at least the methods required by applicable law, and the channels are published in the privacy notice.

criteria.title: Proportionate verification
criteria.req: Requester identity is verified using methods proportionate to the sensitivity of the data and the request, without collecting unnecessary additional information.

criteria.title: Timeliness
criteria.req: Requests are tracked and fulfilled within statutory timelines, with extensions used only where permitted and communicated.

criteria.title: Access and portability
criteria.req: Access requests return the specific personal information held, in a usable and where required portable format.

criteria.title: Deletion including processors
criteria.req: Deletion requests are fulfilled across the organization's systems and communicated to service providers and third parties as required.

criteria.title: Correction
criteria.req: Consumers can correct inaccurate personal information, and corrections propagate to relevant systems and recipients.

criteria.title: Denials, appeals, and non-discrimination
criteria.req: Denied requests are documented with reasons and any appeal route, and consumers are not discriminated against for exercising rights.

domains.name: Data Minimization and Retention
domains.intro: Whether the organization collects only what it needs and lets go of it when it should.

criteria.title: Purpose limitation
criteria.req: Personal information is used only for the purposes disclosed at collection or purposes compatible with them.

criteria.title: Collection limitation
criteria.req: Collection is limited to what is reasonably necessary and proportionate for the disclosed purposes.

criteria.title: Retention enforced
criteria.req: Retention periods are enforced through technical or procedural controls, not only stated in policy.

criteria.title: Secure disposal
criteria.req: Personal information beyond its retention period is disposed of securely, including on backups within a defined period and at vendors.

criteria.title: De-identification standard
criteria.req: Where the organization relies on de-identified or aggregated data, the method meets a recognized standard and re-identification is contractually and technically prohibited.

domains.name: Security Safeguards
domains.intro: Whether the information is protected in proportion to its sensitivity, and whether the organization would know if it were not.

criteria.title: Information security program
criteria.req: A written information security program defines controls proportionate to the sensitivity and volume of personal information processed.

criteria.title: Access control
criteria.req: Access to personal information follows least privilege, is reviewed periodically, and administrative and remote access require multi-factor authentication.

criteria.title: Encryption
criteria.req: Personal information is encrypted in transit and, for sensitive categories, at rest, using current standards with managed keys.

criteria.title: Logging and monitoring
criteria.req: Access to and changes in systems holding personal information are logged, retained, and monitored for anomalies.

criteria.title: Vulnerability management
criteria.req: Systems are assessed for vulnerabilities on a defined cadence, including at least annual independent testing for internet-facing systems, and findings are remediated by severity.

criteria.title: Secure development
criteria.req: Systems that process personal information are built and changed under a process that includes security and privacy review before release.

criteria.title: Incident response
criteria.req: An incident response plan assigns roles, defines escalation, and is exercised at least annually.

criteria.title: Breach notification
criteria.req: A breach procedure determines notification obligations and executes notice to individuals, regulators, and partners within statutory timeframes.
refs: HIPAA Breach Notification Rule where applicable

domains.name: Vendors and Third Parties
domains.intro: Whether the organization's promises survive the handoff to everyone it shares data with.

criteria.title: Processor inventory
criteria.req: Service providers and third parties that receive personal information are inventoried with the data shared and the purpose.

criteria.title: Due diligence
criteria.req: Vendors are assessed for privacy and security practices before receiving personal information, proportionate to the risk of the sharing.

criteria.title: Contract terms
criteria.req: Contracts with recipients of personal information include the terms required by applicable law, including purpose limitation, confidentiality, security, deletion, and cooperation with rights requests.

criteria.title: Cross-border transfers
criteria.req: Where personal information leaves its jurisdiction of collection, a lawful transfer mechanism is in place and documented.
refs: PIPEDA and LGPD transfer provisions where applicable

criteria.title: Ongoing oversight and offboarding
criteria.req: Vendor performance is monitored, and at termination personal information is returned or destroyed with confirmation.

domains.name: Training and Awareness
domains.intro: Whether the people who touch the data know what they are responsible for.

criteria.title: Onboarding training
criteria.req: New personnel who handle personal information complete privacy training before receiving access.

criteria.title: Annual role-based training
criteria.req: Personnel complete privacy training at least annually, with content tailored to the data and processes their role involves.

criteria.title: Handler procedures
criteria.req: Documented procedures exist for personnel who process rights requests, respond to incidents, or handle sensitive categories.

criteria.title: Awareness of reporting
criteria.req: Personnel know how to report suspected incidents and privacy concerns, and reports are acted on without retaliation.
